blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.
blocks.zh: 自动即时优化(APO)对基于文本的LLMs和LLM系统表现出强大的效果,但其在视听理解系统的应用需要合适的文本界面,通过这些界面,多式联运推理可以接触到基于文本的优化器. 我们调查文字界面的设计如何影响迅速优化多式联运推理,即视听问答任务。 我们比较了三种界面设计,包括一个直接推论系统,包括一个单一的OMni-模式大型语言模型(OmniLM),一个标题解释器系统,以及一个代理架构,其中主要代理人管弦OmniLLMs子代理. 与Qune3-Omni和双子座的实验显示,直接的即时优化提供了模型依赖的增益;字幕-推理系统和代理系统暴露出更可解释的优化界面,但更难优化,其中对受优化影响的案例进行错误分析. 我们的研究突出强调了文本界面设计是使全模式推理系统能够迅速优化的重要因素。 GitHub Repo详细介绍了我们的执行情况。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal reasoning requires integrating evidence from multiple modalities to support a decision. In audio-visual question answering (AVQA) task, for example, this may involve identifying relevant evidence from both audio and video, and reasoning over the evidence to answer a question, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
Prior work has improved multimodal reasoning by enhancing chain-of-thought in MLLMs [ 25 , 5 ] ,
while another approach is to verbalize multimodal evidence into text for subsequent language-based reasoning, where rich and faithful textual descriptions, combined with additional reasoning by text LLMs, have been shown to improve downstream performance [ 23 , 6 , 9 , 11 ] .
These findings motivate viewing text as an explicit interface through which multimodal reasoning can be structured and improved.
blocks.zh:
多式联运推理需要综合多种方式的证据来支持一项决定。 例如,在视听问答(AVQA)任务中,这可能涉及从音频和视频中找出相关证据,并如图1所示,对回答问题的证据进行推理。
先前的工作通过增强MLLMs[25,5]中的思想链,改进了多式联运推理,
另一种办法是将多式证据口头化为文字,用于随后的基于语言的推理,其中,丰富而忠实的文字描述,加上文字LLMs的额外推理,都显示出改善了下游的性能[23、6、9、11]。
这些结论促使人们把案文视为一个明确的界面,可以通过这一界面来安排和改进多式联运推理。

blocks.en:
Recent omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs), which jointly process audio, video, and text, have achieved strong performance on audio-visual multimodal reasoning tasks [ 14 , 19 , 20 , 3 , 16 ] .
However, their outputs can be sensitive to how the task is instructed. Different prompt instructions for the same audio-visual input may elicit different perceptual details or organize the resulting evidence differently [ 13 , 10 ] , which may make manual prompt design brittle.
Automatic prompt optimization (APO) addresses this problem by using task feedback to iteratively search for refined instructions. Given proper optimization signals and evidence, they usually propose prompt that performs better on downstream tasks than heuristic designs [ 8 , 12 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
近期的自闭式大语言模型(OmniLLM),它们联合处理音频,视频,和文本,在视听多模式推理任务上取得了强效表现[14,19,20,3,16].
但是,它们的产出对如何指导这项任务可能很敏感。 针对相同视听投入的不同即时指示可能会引起不同的感知细节,或者以不同的方式组织由此产生的证据[13,10],这可能会使人工即时设计变得不易.
自动快速优化(APO)通过使用任务反馈来反复搜索精细指令来解决这个问题. 鉴于适当的优化信号和证据,它们通常提出比高压设计更能执行下游任务的快报[8、12、1]。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Demonstration of LLM reasoning on AVQA.
blocks.zh: 图1:在AVQA上演示LLM推理.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the three systems we investigated and compared for instruction optimization .
blocks.zh: 图 2: 我们为优化教学而调查和比较的三个系统概述。

blocks.en: APO methods optimize textual prompts based on text feedback [ 8 , 12 , 1 ] . Recent multimodal APO methods [ 10 , 2 ] may additionally incorporate multimodal feedback, but the optimized prompts themselves are still represented in text. Therefore, applying APO to a multimodal reasoning system requires the system to expose a textual optimization interface, specifying which textual instructions the optimizer can modify and what feedback or intermediate information is available to guide prompt updates.
blocks.zh: APO方法根据文本反馈优化文本提示 [8, 12, 1]. 近期的多模式的APO方法[10,2]可能会另外纳入多模式反馈,但优化的提示本身仍然体现在文本中. 因此,将APO应用到多模式推理系统需要该系统暴露出文本优化界面,具体说明优化者可以修改哪些文本指令,以及有哪些反馈或中间信息可用来指导即时更新.

blocks.en:
The designs of vision-language interfaces for prompt optimization have been studied in previous works [ 2 , 10 ] , but less on omni-modal reasoning over audio-visual information.
To this end, we raise the research question:
does exposing intermediate multimodal reasoning through explicit textual interfaces make APO more effective than optimizing an end-to-end OmniLLM instruction directly?
Thus we explore two types of audio-visual reasoning systems consisting of multi-LLMs, providing different explicit textual optimization interfaces, 1) a captioner-reasoner system that externalizes multimodal evidence into a textual caption before a separate language model produce an answer to the downstream task;
2) an agentic system where a text-based LLM agent raises queries to OmniLLM subagents to collect multimodal evidence for downstream task. And we compare them with the direct inference system, where a single OmniLLM directly consumes multimodal input to conduct the downstream task.
blocks.zh:
之前的作品[2,10]中已经研究过视觉语言界面用于即时优化的设计,但较少研究对视听信息的全能模式推理.
为此,我们提出研究问题:
通过明确的文本界面披露中间式多式推理是否使APO比直接优化端到端的OmniLM指令更有效?
因此,我们探索了由多LLMs组成的两类视听推理系统,提供了不同的明确文本优化接口,1)一个标题-推理系统,在单独的语言模型产生下游任务的答案之前,将多式证据外部化为文本标题;
2) 一种代理系统,即基于文本的LLM代理向OmniLM子代理商提出询问,为下游任务收集多式证据. 我们将它们与直接推论系统进行比较, 一个单一的OmniLLM直接消耗多模式输入来完成下游任务。

blocks.en:
We study these questions through AVQA benchmarks, where a model must answer questions that depend jointly on the auditory and visual streams of a video [ 26 , 21 , 7 ] . AVQA provides a natural testbed because it requires both retrieving sparsely distributed multimodal evidence and reasoning over the retrieved evidence.
Both systems we study are established paradigms for video QA (VQA) or AVQA. Previous works [ 23 , 13 , 4 ] conducted caption-based VQA/AVQA focusing on properly aggregating captions from frames, inducing question-conditioned descriptions, etc. Agentic video systems instead acquire question-relevant evidence iteratively through OmniLLM observation and tool use [ 17 , 24 , 18 , 15 ] , achieving strong performances. We therefore study captioner-reasoner and agentic systems as representative interfaces for static evidence externalization and dynamic evidence acquisition , respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们通过AVQA基准来研究这些问题,其中一个模型必须回答那些共同依赖于视频的听觉和视觉流的问题[26,21,7]. AVQA提供了一个自然的试验床,因为它既需要检索分布稀少的多式证据,也需要对所取证据进行推理。
我们研究的两个系统都是视频QA(VQA)或AVQA的既定范式. 以往的作品[23,13,4]进行了基于字幕的VQA/AVQA,侧重于从帧中正确汇总字幕,诱导有问题条件的描述等. 代理视频系统则通过OmniLM观测和工具使用来迭代地获取与问题相关的证据[17,24,18,15],实现强性能. 因此,我们研究字幕解释器和代理系统,分别作为静态证据外部化和动态证据获取的代表性接口。

blocks.en:
While prior work primarily designs such systems to improve task performance, we instead study how effectively their intermediate textual interfaces interact with APO, compared with direct OmniLLM inference. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of textual interface design for APO in audio-visual reasoning systems.
Through controlled experiments and error analyses of reasoning trajectories and action traces, we identify distinct limitations in captioner-reasoner and agentic systems, providing insights into further investigation on design and optimization of textual interfaces for audio-visual reasoning.
blocks.zh:
虽然以前的工作主要是设计这种系统来改进任务性能,但我们却研究其中间文本界面与APO的交互效果,与直接的OmniLLM推论相比. 据我们所知,这是首次系统研究视听推理系统中APO的文字界面设计.
通过对推理轨迹和行动痕迹的有控制的实验和错误分析,我们找出了字幕-推理和代理系统中的明显局限性,为进一步调查视听推理文字界面的设计和优化提供了深刻见解。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
In AVQA, the audio-visual reasoning system aims to predict the correct answer y y , given a video v v with audio a a , a question q q , and answer options o o . This section introduces three system architectures that differ in how audio-visual evidence is exposed through textual interfaces and, consequently, where
textual instructions can be optimized. All LLM parameters are kept frozen. Three systems consist of OmniLLMs and optionally text-only LLMs. In following sections, ℳ \mathcal{M} denotes an OmniLLM and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} denotes a text-only LLM, with subscripts indicating their functional roles. ϕ \phi denotes each optimizable prompt, belonging to its corresponding LLM component constructing different systems.
blocks.zh:
在AVQA中,视听推理系统旨在预测正确的答案y y,给一个视频v,一个音频a,一个问题q q,并回答选项o o. 本节介绍三种不同的系统架构,即视听证据如何通过文字界面曝光,以及因此在何处披露。
可优化文本指令。 所有LLM参数均被冻结. 三个系统由OmniLLM和可选的只用文本的LLM组成. 在以下各节中, M\ mathcal{M} 表示 OmniLLM 和 T\ mathcal{T} 表示仅文本的 LLM, 下标表示其功能作用 。\\\phi表示每个可选择的快取,属于相应的LLM组件构建不同的系统.

blocks.en: 2.1 Direct OmniLLM Inference
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 直接 OmniLLM 推论

blocks.en:
We first consider the simplest setting, where an end-to-end (e2e) OmniLLM directly performs AVQA. The model jointly receives the video v v , audio a a , question q q , and answer options o o , and makes prediction y ^ = ℳ e2e ​ ( v , a , q , o , ϕ e2e ) \hat{y}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{e2e}}(v,a,q,o;\phi_{\mathrm{e2e}}) . ℳ e2e \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{e2e}} denotes the OmniLLM used for end-to-end inference and ϕ e2e \phi_{\mathrm{e2e}} is its textual task instruction, informing the model that it should conduct the AVQA task and optionally the procedures and rules to follow.
This system exposes the direct-inference textual interface ϕ e2e \phi_{\mathrm{e2e}} .
blocks.zh:
我们首先考虑最简单的设置,即端到端(e2e) OmniLLM直接执行AVQA. 该模型联合接收了视频 v , 音频 a, question q, 并回答选项 o , 并做出预测 y = M e2e (v, a, q, o, φ e2e)\hat{y}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{e2e}}(v,a,q,o;\phi_{\mathrm{e}}) 。 。 。 。 M e2e\ mathcal{M}_{\ mathrm{e2e} 表示用于端到端推断的 OmniLLM,而 e2e\phi_{\ mathrm{e2e}是它的文本任务指令,告知模型它应该执行AVQA任务,并且可以选择遵循的程序和规则.
此系统暴露出直引文本接口 \\ e2e\phi\ mathrm{ e2e} 。

blocks.en: 2.2 Captioner-reasoner System
blocks.zh: 2.2 说明理由系统

blocks.en:
We next consider a two-stage captioner-reasoner system.
The captioner produces c = ℳ cap ​ ( v , a , ϕ cap ) c=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{cap}}(v,a;\phi_{\mathrm{cap}}) , without knowing the question and options. ℳ cap \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{cap}} denotes the OmniLLM captioner, and ϕ cap \phi_{\mathrm{cap}} is its textual instruction. A text-only reasoner then predicts y ^ = 𝒯 rea ​ ( q , o , c , ϕ rea ) \hat{y}=\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{rea}}(q,o,c;\phi_{\mathrm{rea}}) , where 𝒯 rea \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{rea}} denotes the reasoning LLM and ϕ rea \phi_{\mathrm{rea}} its instruction.
This system exposes two optimizable instructions: the captioner instruction ϕ cap \phi_{\mathrm{cap}} and the reasoner instruction ϕ rea \phi_{\mathrm{rea}} .

此系统会曝光两个可选择的指令: 标题指令 \\\ phi\ mathrm{ cap} 和 理由指令 \ rea\ phi\ mathrm{ rea} 。

blocks.en: 2.3 Agent-Subagent System
blocks.zh: 2.3 代理人-试剂系统

blocks.en:
We further consider an agent-subagent system where the text-based LLM agent interactively acquires audio-visual evidence from OmniLLM subagents, and then makes the answer decision.
The primary agent cannot inspect the raw video or directly answer the question without calling a subagent. However, it provides longer context window length not consumed by the large amount of multimodal input, allowing itself to memorize information collected from multiple interaction turns with subagents and reason from such memory.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步考虑一种代理-辅助系统,即基于文本的LLM代理通过交互方式从OmniLLM子代理获取视听证据,然后做出回答决定。
主代理不能检查生视频或直接回答问题而不呼叫子代理. 然而,它提供了没有被大量多式输入所消耗的更长的上下文窗口长度,使自己能够记住从与子剂的多个交互转折中收集的信息和从这种内存中获取的理由.

blocks.en: We adopt one subagent for captioning and another for responding to multimodal evidence-collection queries issued by the text agent. The captioner summarizes globally salient events and provides temporal information about these events, while details omitted from the caption can be further collected through targeted queries, conditioned on the current evidence in captions. These two types of tools are widely adopted in agentic audio and video understanding systems and have demonstrated their effectiveness [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们采用一个字幕子代理,另一个用于答复文本代理提出的多式取证询问。 该标题概述了全球突出事件,并提供了有关这些事件的时间信息,而标题中遗漏的细节可通过有针对性的查询进一步收集,并以标题中的现有证据为条件。 这两类工具被广泛应用于代理音频和视频理解系统,并证明了其有效性[15].

blocks.en:
At each interaction step t t , the text agent 𝒯 agt \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{agt}} takes an action based on q q , o o , and interaction history h t h_{t} .
The workflow always begins with a captioning call to obtain a description of the audio-visual content.
At each subsequent step, 𝒯 agt \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{agt}} decides its next action: z t = 𝒯 agt ​ ( q , o , h t , ϕ agt ) . z_{t}=\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{agt}}(q,o,h_{t};\phi_{\mathrm{agt}}). The action z t z_{t} can be requesting another caption, raising a follow-up query u t u_{t} to a query-response component to collect information useful for answering the original question, or producing the final answer once adequate evidence has been collected.
Both the captioning component and the query-response component are OmniLLMs, just playing different roles.
The captioner component is defined as c t = ℳ cap ​ ( v , a , ϕ cap ) c_{t}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{cap}}(v,a;\phi_{\mathrm{cap}}) ,
and the follow-up query responder component as r t = ℳ resp ​ ( v , a , u t , ϕ resp ) r_{t}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{resp}}(v,a,u_{t};\phi_{\mathrm{resp}}) .

blocks.en: This system exposes multiple textual prompts for optimization, most notably ϕ agt \phi_{\mathrm{agt}} . The perception-side prompts ϕ cap \phi_{\mathrm{cap}} and ϕ resp \phi_{\mathrm{resp}} are also optimizable, and can be adaptively raised by the text agent.

blocks.en: 2.4 Automatic Prompt Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.4 自动快速优化

blocks.en:
During optimization, the system is executed on training examples, whose ground truths are available, using the current instruction ϕ \phi . The optimizer ℱ \mathcal{F} , which is a text-based LLM, observes optimization evidence e e together with the predicted answer y ^ \hat{y} and ground-truth answer y y , and proposes a revised instruction, ϕ ′ = ℱ opt ​ ( ϕ , e , y , y ^ ) . \phi^{\prime}=\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{opt}}(\phi,e,y,\hat{y}). (1) The evidence may include the model response, intermediate reasoning
trajectory, or, for the agent-subagent system, the interaction trace
containing agent actions and subagent observations.
blocks.zh:
在优化期间,该系统在培训实例上执行,这些实例的地面真相是可以获得的,使用目前的指令 \\\\phi 。 优化者 F\ mathcal{F} 是一个基于文本的 LLM , 观察优化证据 e 与预测的答案 y\ hat{y} 和 地- 真相 y y , 并提出修改后的指示 φ = F 选择 ( φ, e, y, y ^ ).\phi^{\prime}=\ mathcal{ F}_{\ mathrm{ opt} (\phi, e, y,\ hat{y}) 。 (1) 证据可包括模型反应、中间推理
轨迹,或对于剂-增生系统而言,相互作用跟踪
包含代理动作和子代理观测。

blocks.en:
The optimizer iteratively searches over candidate instructions using the training examples. We use QA accuracy as the task-level optimization objective for all APO algorithms. Candidate instructions produced during the search are evaluated on the validation set,
and the instruction with the highest validation accuracy within the specified optimization budget is selected as the final optimized instruction, to be evaluated on the held-out test set.
blocks.zh:
优化者利用培训实例反复搜索候选人的说明。 我们使用QA精度作为所有APO算法的任务级优化目标. 在搜索过程中制作的候选说明在验证组上得到评价,
并且选择在指定的优化预算范围内具有最高验证精度的指令作为最终优化指令,在停放测试集上进行评估.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate APO for AVQA on Daily-Omni [ 26 ] , comparing direct single-MLLM inference, captioner-reasoner pipelines, and agentic system, particularly their compatibilities with an APO algorithm GEPA [ 1 ] , with brief reference experiment on APO algorithm COPRO [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们通过Daily-Omni[26]来评价AVQA的APO,比较直接的单MLLM推论,标题推理管道,以及代理系统,特别是它们与APO算法的相容性GEPA[1],同时对APO算法COPRO进行简短的参考实验[12].

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate on Daily-Omni [ 26 ] , which contains 1,197 audio-visual multiple-choice QA examples spanning six task categories. Since APO requires examples for prompt search and validation-based candidate selection, we stratify the benchmark into 125 training, 125 validation, and 947 held-out test examples,
preserving the overall task-category distribution.
The training set is used during prompt optimization, the validation set for selecting candidate instructions, and the held-out test set as the primary measure of optimization effectiveness. We additionally report full-benchmark accuracy in case for comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们通过Daily-Omni [26] 来评价,其中包含1,197个涉及六个任务类别的视听多重选择QA实例. 由于APO需要以实例进行快速搜索和基于验证的候选人甄选,我们把基准分成125个培训、125个验证和947个搁置测试实例,
保留整个任务类别分布。
培训集在即时优化期间被使用,用于选择候选指令的验证集,被搁置的测试集被作为优化效果的主要衡量标准. 我们还报告完整的基准准确性,以便进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models and Systems
blocks.zh: 3.2 模型和系统

blocks.en:

Qwen3-Omni is served locally, while Gemini-2.5-Flash is accessed via the Google API.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 APO on the Direct-Inference Interface
blocks.zh: 4.1 关于直接推论接口的APO

blocks.en:
We first evaluate whether automatic prompt optimization (APO) can improve the direct QA interface of an OmniLLM.
Tables 1 and 2 report the results on Qwen3-Omni and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评价自动即时优化(APO)是否能够改进一个OmniLLM的直接QA接口.
表1和表2分别报告了Quen3-Omni和双子座-2.5-Flash的结果。

blocks.en:
For Qwen3-Omni, neither COPRO nor GEPA consistently improves direct QA performance. On Qwen3-Omni-Instruct, both optimizers slightly reduce test accuracy relative to the unoptimized prompt.
Qwen3-Omni-Think exhibits a similar pattern: results after executing COPRO and GEPA is comparable with baseline accuracy on the test set, suggesting that exposing a more explicit chain-of-thought reasoning process does not make APO more effective on the direct interface.
blocks.zh:
对Qune3-Omni来说,COPRO和GEPA都没有一贯改善直接的质量保证表现. 在Qwen3-Omni-Instruct上,两个优化器相比未优化的快取略微降低了测试精度.
Qune3-Omni-Think呈现出类似模式:执行COPRO和GEPA后的结果与测试集的基线精度相当,这表明揭露更明确的思维链推理过程并不能使APO在直接界面上更加有效.

blocks.en:
In contrast, Gemini-2.5-Flash (abbreviated to Gemini) benefits clearly from GEPA. The test accuracy improves from 75.71 % 75.71\% to 79.83 % 79.83\% (by 4.12%), with overall accuracy also showing an increase. COPRO also brings about an accuracy gain of 2.54 % 2.54\% .
The performance gain obtained by APO on Gemini may be due to the stronger instruction-following capacity of the model, compared to with the Qwen3-Omni models. We therefore primarily use Gemini as the OmniLLM, and GEPA as the APO due to its more stable performance gain across the validation and test splits, in the following case studies on the other two reasoning systems.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,双子座-2.5-Flash(缩写为双子座)明显受益于GEPA. 测试精度由75.71 % 75.71 %提高到79.83% 79.83 % (增加了4.12%),总体精度也显示出上升. COPRO还带来2.54%的精度增益 2.54\%.
APO在双子座上获得的性能收益可能是由于该模型比起Quen3-Omni模型更强大的指令跟随能力. 因此,我们主要使用双子座作为OmniLLM,GEPA作为APO,因为它在整个验证和测试分裂中都获得了更稳定的性能收益,在以下关于另外两个推理系统的案例研究中.

blocks.en: 4.2 APO on the Captioner-Reasoner Interface
blocks.zh: 4.2 说明-Reasoner接口上的APO

blocks.en:
The results of experimenting APO on the captioner-reasoner system are shown in Table 3 .
The captioner-reasoner decomposition itself incurs a substantial performance drop compared with direct Gemini inference. Using the same Gemini-generated captions, both Gemini and GPT-4.1 reasoners obtain around 5% accuracy
less than the direct inference. The discrepancy between the reasoner and captioner models did not lead to further accuracy drops.
The drop is possibly because caption forms an information bottleneck between perception and reasoning: the captioner must compress the audio-visual input to text descriptions without knowing which details are key to the question. The downstream reasoner has to make decision on ambiguous observations.
blocks.zh:
在标题-理由系统上试验APO的结果见表3。
与直接的双子座推论相比,字幕-推理分解器本身的性能大幅下降. 使用相同的双子星生成的字幕,双子星和GPT-4.1 双子星均获得约5%的精确度
比直接推论少. 理由模型和标题模型之间的差异没有导致进一步的精度下降.
下降可能是因为字幕在感知和推理之间形成了信息瓶颈:字幕员必须在不知道哪些细节是问题的关键的情况下将视听输入压缩到文本描述. 下游的原因者必须就模棱两可的意见作出决定。

blocks.en: Moreover, providing additional textual interfaces, from only ϕ e ​ 2 ​ e \phi_{e2e} to ϕ c ​ a ​ p \phi_{cap} and ϕ r ​ e ​ a \phi_{rea} , does not make this architecture easier to optimize. Applying APO to either the caption instruction or the reasoner instruction fails to improve accuracy on the held-out test split. In both cases, validation accuracy increases more strongly than test accuracy. For caption optimization, the validation accuracy rises drastically, while test accuracy decreases from 2.01 % 2.01\% This large discrepancy suggests that the captioning interface is especially brittle to prompt changes, making it an unreliable target for APO in this setting. Optimizing the reasoner is stable, but does not provide improvement.

blocks.en: 4.3 APO on the Agent-subagent Interface
blocks.zh: 4.3 关于代理-增殖剂接口的APO

blocks.en:
We implemented the agent-subagent system as a ReAct-style pipeline [ 22 ] , and applied GEPA. As shown in Table 4 , its
performance remains comparable to direct Gemini inference, while
GEPA does not improve held-out accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们实施了作为ReAct式输油管的放水剂系统,并应用了GEPA。 如表4所示,
性能仍与直接双子座推论相当,而
GEPA没有提高搁置的准确性。

blocks.en:
To understand the behavior of the agentic interface, we inspect
samples whose correctness changes between direct inference and ReAct.
Among direct-correct but ReAct-wrong cases, the dominant failures are
conflicting perception evidence (61.7%) and incorrect reasoning over
otherwise useful evidence (27.3%). Conversely, ReAct improvements
mainly come from retrieving additional useful evidence or richer
captions. Thus, active evidence acquisition in the agent system can recover missing information, but can also introduce extra failure points.

其正确性在直接推论和ReAct之间变化的样本。

认知证据冲突(61.7%)和推理不正确
其他有用的证据(27.3%)。 相反,ReAct改进
主要来自获取更多有用的证据或更丰富的证据
标题。 因此,代理系统中的活性证据获取可以回收缺失的信息,但也能够引入额外的故障点.

blocks.en:
When applying GEPA on the agentic system, it succeeded in finding an optimized prompt with improved validation accuracy during prompt search, but the improvement does not transfer to test. This discrepancy suggests that the agentic interface is difficult to optimize reliably.
Table 5 further shows that GEPA
acts on different scopes in the two interfaces. The optimized direct
prompt mainly constrains evidence grounding at the final decision,
whereas the optimized ReAct prompt changes a longer chain involving
caption interpretation, query formulation, evidence acquisition, and
integration. Accordingly, GEPA substantially changes the interaction
strategy, reducing the calls to query-responder by 35.8% and total tool calls by 15.0%, yet yielding no gains in held-out accuracy. There are few potential explanations. One is that final-answer correctness alone may provide a weak optimization signal for a multi-stage agentic interface. Or the perception and reasoning ability of the LLM components set limits on how the agentic system can perform.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We study whether externalize audio-visual reasoning of OmniLLM-based systems through explicit textual interfaces makes APO more effective than directly optimizing an OmniLLM instruction,which we found is not uniformly the case. APO substantially improves direct Gemini inference, reaching 79.62% overall accuracy on Daily-Omni, despite it not producing much gain on Qwen3-Omni models. In contrast, the captioner-reasoner and agentic systems expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but obtain no reliable improvement from APO. Our error and trajectory analyses reveal interface-specific failure modes, including information loss in captioning, conflicting perception evidence, and downstream reasoning errors. Our results suggest that explicit textual interfaces make multimodal reasoning easier to inspect and steer, but not necessarily make APO more effective.
blocks.zh: 我们研究通过明确的文字界面将基于OmniLLM的系统的视听推理外部化是否使得APO比直接优化OmniLLM指令更有效,我们发现情况并不一致. APO大幅度地改进了直接的双子座推论,在"Daily-Omni"上达到79.62%的总精度,尽管它并没有对Qun3-Omni模型产生很大的收益. 相形之下,标题解释器和代理系统暴露出更可解释的优化界面,但没有从APO获得可靠的改进. 我们的错误和轨迹分析揭示了特定接口的故障模式,包括标题上的信息丢失、认知证据相冲突以及下游推理错误。 我们的结果表明,明确的文字界面使多式联运推理更容易检查和引导,但不一定使亚太办事处更加有效。
